subject.title: skill_workshop: quarantined proposals are CLI dead-ends (no apply/revise/reject path back)

question: Which recovery transition should Skill Workshop support for quarantined proposals?
rationale: Current shipped docs and tests make non-pending proposals terminal, and changing quarantined recovery affects both public lifecycle surfaces and security semantics.

options.title: Add audited quarantine recovery
options.body: Support a bounded path such as dismissing quarantined proposals and allowing revise-to-pending only after a fresh clean scan and audit update.

options.title: Unify with restore naming
options.body: Wait for the rejected-proposal restore direction to settle, then extend the same public restore/reopen model to quarantined proposals if maintainers want one recovery verb.

options.title: Keep quarantine terminal
options.body: Document quarantine as an immutable safety hold and close this direction only if users are expected to recreate clean proposals instead.

recommendation.title: Add audited quarantine recovery
recommendation.body: Support a bounded path such as dismissing quarantined proposals and allowing revise-to-pending only after a fresh clean scan and audit update.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature-introduction history makes this the strongest available code-owner routing signal for the proposal lifecycle contract.
